units.RateLv: original integer ratio units; preserve every source skill rank
units.Energy: original client units, not normalized or implicitly ER-scaled
units.ElementPower: original client field; source type and cast-level gains require separate review

reviewPolicy: Select action IDs explicitly and join to canonical action identity, curve, hit multiplicity, damage type and scaling before use. Prefix membership alone does not qualify a playable attack.
Healing/utility/dummy rows are preserved as raw source; never treat every row as damage. Missing fields are absent, not zero.
Timing and trigger semantics must be reviewed separately; these quantities alone do not declare a full native module.
No private calculator, fixtures or DPS values are included.
